   "source": [
    "# Quick start\n",
    "\n",
    "In this quick tutorial we will learn how to create a simple model with one point source, with a power law spectrum. You can of course use any function instead of the power law. Use ```list_models()``` to obtain a list of available models.\n",
    "\n",
    "Let’s define the model:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "f6805297",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-05-07T22:27:41.121942Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-05-07T22:27:41.121768Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-05-07T22:27:44.198227Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-05-07T22:27:44.196495Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "%%capture\n",
    "from astromodels import *"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "0d30985c",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-05-07T22:27:44.205170Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-05-07T22:27:44.204717Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-05-07T22:27:44.210405Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-05-07T22:27:44.208436Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "test_source = PointSource(\n",
    "    \"test_source\", ra=123.22, dec=-13.56, spectral_shape=Powerlaw_flux()\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "my_model = Model(test_source)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "71ff08fb",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Now let’s use it:\n",
    "\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "58711ece",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-05-07T22:27:44.214868Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-05-07T22:27:44.214028Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-05-07T22:27:44.864325Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-05-07T22:27:44.863469Z"
    },
    "lines_to_next_cell": 2
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Differential flux @ 1 keV : 1.010 photons / ( cm2 s keV)\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Get and print the differential flux at 1 keV:\n",
    "\n",
    "differential_flux_at_1_keV = my_model.test_source(1.0)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\n",
    "    \"Differential flux @ 1 keV : %.3f photons / ( cm2 s keV)\"\n",
    "    % differential_flux_at_1_keV\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "94e7d24e",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Evaluate the model on an array of 100 energies logarithmically distributed between 1 and 100 keV and plot it"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "71cf9c28",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-05-07T22:27:44.866180Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-05-07T22:27:44.866052Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-05-07T22:27:46.099830Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-05-07T22:27:46.099253Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "Text(0, 0.5, 'Differential flux (ph./cm2/s/keV)')"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 4,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1040x910 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "%matplotlib inline\n",
    "from jupyterthemes import jtplot\n",
    "\n",
    "jtplot.style(context=\"talk\", fscale=1, ticks=True, grid=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Set up the energies\n",
    "\n",
    "energies = np.logspace(0, 2, 100)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Get the differential flux\n",
    "\n",
    "differential_flux = my_model.test_source(energies)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots()\n",
    "\n",
    "ax.loglog(energies, differential_flux)\n",
    "\n",
    "ax.set_xlabel(\"Energy (keV)\")\n",
    "ax.set_ylabel(\"Differential flux (ph./cm2/s/keV)\")"
   ]
  }
 ],
